overview: AI tools streamline operational tasks in SMBs, boosting efficiency and cash flow.

top.title: Franchisee reconciles cash in 94% less time with ChatGPT Work
top.summary: A Schlotzsky’s/Cinnabon franchisee used OpenAI’s ChatGPT Work to cut menu repricing from five days to 1‑2 hours, freeing up to $100K cash flow and reducing payroll run time by four hours.

top.title: Terminal X matches senior investor judgment 88.6% with GPT-6.1
top.summary: Terminal X integrated GPT‑6.1 Sol into its Capital Memory system, achieving 88.6% alignment with senior investor judgments, detecting 25% more mandate deviations, and lowering query costs by ~30%.

top.title: ChatGPT now lets you lock your chats
top.summary: OpenAI added Locked Chats to ChatGPT, allowing users to protect sensitive conversations with a PIN or biometric lock, separating them from regular history without providing end‑to‑end encryption.

top.title: ALTK-Evolve: How learned memory tops the τ²-bench leaderboard on customer service tasks without a frontier model
top.summary: Hugging Face’s ALTK‑Evolve uses GPT‑4.1 to extract behavioral guidelines for a customer‑service agent, boosting τ²‑bench retail performance to 67.5% without model weight updates.

top.title: A visit to Samsung’s massive new semiconductor hub
top.summary: Samsung is expanding its Pyeongtaek semiconductor complex with new fabs to meet rising AI memory chip demand, aiming to sustain growth through 2028 and compete with SK Hynix and TSMC.

top.title: AnyLanguageModel 1.0: One Year of Local Models on Apple Platforms
top.summary: AnyLanguageModel 1.0 unifies local and hosted LLM inference on Apple platforms, adding support for multiple providers, reasoning, and cross‑platform code, simplifying app development with a single API.
